Hi Ben,

Thanks — I signed up on your site this morning. Before we do a longer product demo I wanted to do a very short technical sanity check (15 minutes) to make sure Redwood will fit into our streaming inference pattern and to confirm model-size/latency expectations.

High-level: were an early-stage ML infra team running mixed batch/streaming traffic, primary models are Llama2 13B and a custom 7B. Key constraints: 128 token average responses, pref latency 100-150ms tail, and we host in eu-central. Would appreciate a quick look to validate fit + any red flags before we schedule a full demo.

Are you able to hop on a 15-minute call tomorrow or Wednesday? Timezone: CET (UTC+1).

Thanks,
Evan
